To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the vast majority of knowledge base relations are implicit, (2) unary relations are very useful in inferring missing entity mentions, (3) deep learning architectures are very effective in identifying such unary relations and (4) a new benchmark is proposed for Knowledge Base Population.

(a) a large number of implicit relationships can be detected by using unary relations and (b) deep learning based approaches can be used very successfully to learn a large number of unary relationships.

(i) unary relations are a very effective and efficient way to infer missing entities, (ii) a deep learning approach is the best way to learn unary relations, and (iii) our approach outperforms the state-of-the-art on web scale knowledge base completion.
